style: Editorial ink-and-wash illustration with confident brush outlines and a restrained palette: deep ink blue-black, warm gilt yellow (#d8a21a), Postext blue (#2b4acb), soft paper whites and warm greys; calm, intelligent mood, like the illustrations of a well-designed technical book.
suffix: Clean artwork only: no text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no speech balloons, no captions, no sound-effect lettering, no signature, no logo, no panel border, no frame; the picture runs to the edges of the image. Any page, screen or book shown carries only grey lines suggesting text, never legible letters.

items.prompt: Character reference sheet on a plain pure white background, two full-body figures standing side by side in a neutral pose, front three-quarter view, evenly spaced with a wide white gap between them so each can be cut out separately, no shadows on the ground, no background scenery. Left: Marta, the editor, a woman in her sixties with short grey hair in a neat bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, a deep blue cardigan over a white blouse, grey trousers, holding a red pencil. Right: Leo, the designer, a man in his late twenties with short curly dark hair and a short beard, a mustard-yellow sweater, dark jeans, white sneakers.
